en.title: Prepositions with countries and cities
en.goal: Use à, en, au and aux correctly with the names of cities and countries.

blocks.title: à + city
blocks.body: To say that something happens in a city, you always use à — with no article before the city name, and no need to worry about gender.

blocks.title: en + feminine country / au + masculine country
blocks.body: Most countries whose name ends in -e are feminine and use en. The others (masculine) use au.
examples: I am going to France. (la France, feminine)
He works in Brazil. (le Brésil, masculine)

blocks.title: aux + plural country
blocks.body: Some countries have a plural name — like les États-Unis (the United States). In that case, the preposition becomes aux.
examples: They live in the United States.
